summary: Frontend-only Turkish ATS CV Builder tested end-to-end via Playwright on desktop viewport (1920x1080). All 12 requested scenarios pass. Sample data loads on first render, live preview updates in real time, ATS score shows %100 with sample, all 8 accordion sections present, Experience add/remove + current-checkbox disables end-date + bullets work, Skills add via Enter + preview reflects, Languages add + level select work, Load Sample / Clear form work, localStorage persistence verified after reload, and most importantly PDF download triggers with filename 'Ahmet_Yılmaz_CV.pdf' (contains CV, has Turkish glyphs). Button transitions to 'Hazırlanıyor...' during generation. Zero JS console errors / page errors captured.
seed_data_creation: None; app auto-seeds Ahmet Yılmaz sample on first load.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is a client-side only React app. localStorage key is 'ats-cv-data-v1'. Clear localStorage before tests for consistent sample-data state. PDF is client-side via @react-pdf/renderer; use page.expect_download() to capture. All 8 accordion sections and add/remove flows have proper data-testid attributes. Turkish glyph rendering in PDF is confirmed by main agent externally.
